Q01.why: no column holds closure_contacts, expense_2025 (1 of 3 match)
Q01.sql:
WITH closures_by_site AS (
  SELECT
    fc.site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fc.cif_number) AS cancelling_customers,
    COUNT(*) AS closure_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` fc
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_account_closures` fac
    ON fc.customer_key = fac.customer_key
  WHERE fc.is_account_closure_call
  GROUP BY fc.site_id
),
site_cost AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_id AS site_id,
    SUM(cc.expense) AS total_cost_last_year
  FROM `fennmoor-analytics.sbx_finance.cc_cost_per_call_fy25` cc
  WHERE cc.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'
  GROUP BY cc.cc_id
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  s.city,
  s.state,
  cb.closure_calls,
  cb.cancelling_customers,
  sc.total_cost_last_year
FROM closures_by_site cb
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` s
  ON cb.site_id = s.site_id
LEFT JOIN site_cost sc
  ON s.site_id = sc.site_id
ORDER BY cb.closure_calls DESC;

Q02.sql:
WITH high_balance_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    segment,
    churn_risk_band,
    churn_probability
  FROM `fennmoor-analytics.looker_scratch.LR_6H0IZB3PQ4C6N_customer_facts`
  WHERE total_deposit_balance >= 100000
)

SELECT
  segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS high_balance_customers,
  AVG(churn_probability) AS avg_churn_probability,
  COUNTIF(churn_risk_band = 'HIGH') AS high_risk_customers,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(churn_risk_band = 'HIGH'), COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key)) AS pct_high_risk
FROM high_balance_customers
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY pct_high_risk DESC

WITH eom AS (
  SELECT
    account_key,
    product_code,
    DATE_TRUNC(balance_date, MONTH) AS month,

Q09.why: no column holds delinquency_rate (2 of 3 match)
Q09.sql:
WITH OPEN_LOANS AS (
  SELECT
    PRODUCT_CODE,
    BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE ACCOUNT_FAMILY = 'LOAN'
    AND IS_OPEN
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DLQ AS (
  SELECT
    A.PRODUCT_CODE,
    A.BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS D
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` DD
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` A USING (ACCOUNT_KEY)
  WHERE DD.DPD >= 30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  O.PRODUCT_CODE,
  B.BRANCH_NAME,
  O.N AS OPEN_LOANS,
  COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0) AS DELINQUENT_LOANS,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(DLQ.D, O.N) AS DELINQUENCY_RATE
FROM OPEN_LOANS O
LEFT JOIN DLQ USING (PRODUCT_CODE, BRANCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` B ON B.BRANCH_ID = O.BRANCH_ID
ORDER BY DELINQUENCY_RATE DESC
